bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · MACD turned down
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · MACD 转弱

read.en: Lumentum slipped 0.7% on Oct 13 to $987.99 after a low of $952.01, and is down 13% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($1,049) and 10-day ($1,057) averages and above the 30-day ($963.1), 100-day ($877.3) and 200-day ($770.2). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 13 and remains above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($1,143), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月13日下跌 0.7%，收于 $987.99，盘中低点 $952.01，五个交易日下跌 13%。股价位于 5 日（$1,049）和 10 日均线（$1,057）下方，并在 30 日（$963.1）、100 日（$877.3）和 200 日均线（$770.2）上方。MACD 于 10月13日下穿信号线，仍在零轴上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$1,143），RSI 为 50。

read.en: The pullback is now confirmed on MACD, and the intraday low tested the 30-day zone without closing below it. Resistance is $1,007 (September shelf), then $1,049–1,057 (5 and 10-day averages) and the $1,143 record. Support is $952–963 (Oct 13 low and 30-day average), then $881 (Sep 28 low) and $832 (Sep 15 low). A close below $952 would open $881.
read.zh: MACD 已确认此轮回调，盘中低点测试 30 日均线区域但收盘未跌破。阻力为 $1,007（9月平台），其次 $1,049–1,057（5 日和 10 日均线）及 $1,143 纪录高点。支撑为 $952–963（10月13日低点及 30 日均线），其次 $881（9月28日低点）和 $832（9月15日低点）。若收盘跌破 $952，下一目标看 $881。
